messages:
ash: publishbot attempted a prod-canary promote but deploy-bot blocked it due to an out-of-range provenance attestation timestamp :warning:
deploy-bot: promote blocked for digest sha256:3f9a...b1c2 - provenance.cosign_kms_ts=2024-10-28T04:42:00Z (allowed-grace=24h)
nora: ack. this looks like the EU mirror KMS rotation again; attestations stamped older than the rotation window
devon: options: rollback canary to prev digest, or pin canary and republish corrected image. pin + republish is less noisy for traffic
ash: agree pin. propose short change window on prod-canary and coordinated republish to prod-temp then promote
release-bot: creating RB ticket RB-4201 and annotating thread
ops-bot: RB-4201 created (label: provenance, priority: P2)
ash: steps I propose:
1) lock prod-canary lane (deployctl) for 20m change window
2) pin affected services to last-known-good digest sha256:2a88...77ff
3) ops republish to prod-temp with fresh cosign attestation using mirror KMS and include labels to mark resync
4) promote prod-temp->prod-canary, run smoke + canary checks, then unpin
5) publish a short release-note blurb calling out the pin + new digest and link RB-4201
nora: add `provenance.mirror=eu-west-1` and `provenance.resynced_by=devon` labels on republished image so we can filter these later
devon: I'll take republish. granting request for temporary KMS access now. pushing to prod-temp:resync and will cosign after push
ash: lock command:
```
deployctl lock --lane=prod-canary --reason=\"provenance resync; pin during republish\" --duration=20m
```

ash: example pin command:
```
redwoodctl service pin --service=checkout-canary --digest=sha256:2a88...77ff --note=\"pin during RB-4201 republish\"
```

release-bot: automated promote attempt 1795554321-1 blocked; attached RB-4201
(2m pass)
devon: push finished to prod-temp. new digest sha256:9c11...aa55. cosign attestation created kms_ts=2024-11-06T10:02:00Z. labels added: provenance.mirror=eu-west-1, provenance.resynced_by=devon, provenance.tool=publishbot-v3
ops-bot: audit log: user=devon action=republish target=prod-temp digest=sha256:9c11...aa55 ticket=RB-4201

release-bot: attempting promote: `promote --from=prod-temp --to=prod-canary --strategy=canary`
deploy-bot: promote succeeded. canary checks running: latency, error-rate, integration smoke
deploy-bot: canary checks green after 5m :white_check_mark:
ash: waiting 5m observation, then unpin and remove lock
release-bot: drafting release notes: \"hotfix: pinned prod-canary to sha256:2a88...77ff during provenance resync; new image sha256:9c11...aa55 promoted after resync (RB-4201). See #release-notes for details.\" posting now
nora: also notify teams that rely on floating tags to verify manifest caches; some infra pulls use cached manifests and may need a docker pull --no-cache or digest pinning
devon: follow-up created ORG-2305 - add alert when mirror attestations post-rotation are older than 12h and automate resync workflow
ash: thanks all. I'll unpin after the 5m window and close RB-4201 once release notes & RB ticket updated. :thumbsup:
